topics.say: Welcome, Guardians! The Crimson Drake nests atop the northeast spire. How can I aid your party?

choices.label: Ask how to unlock the spire gate

crest_hint.say: East of the south gate sits the Guardian Crystal. Attune to it to receive the Citadel Crest, then march north and east to the spire terrace.

farewell.say: May the Crystal's light guide your blades!
